title: Port Perry Repair Café returns for another season — and the lineup is longer than ever
excerpt: Volunteers at the monthly Repair Café have fixed over 300 items since launching two years ago. "People come in defeated and leave amazed," says organizer Barb Hennessey. "Mostly amazed that someone just did it for free."

title: Blackstock General Store bulletin board: the original social network
excerpt: It's a corkboard. It's been there since 1987. And according to residents of south Scugog, it still tells you more about what's actually happening in the community than anything on your phone.

title: Scugog Mutual Aid Network quietly helped 40 families through last winter
excerpt: No press release. No fundraiser. Just neighbours coordinating rides, firewood, and emergency groceries through a Facebook group most people don't know exists. This is what the safety net actually looks like.
